## Change

Describe the user-visible or research-contract change.

## Evidence

- [ ] Tests cover the behavior.
- [ ] Release audit passes.
- [ ] Public schemas/docs are updated when needed.
- [ ] No credentials, private data, reference PDFs, generated runs, or incompatible code are included.

## Operator changes

- [ ] Passport and lineage are present, or not applicable.
- [ ] Candidate and baseline use matched budgets, or not applicable.
- [ ] Held-out results, regressions, costs, and negative cases are reported, or not applicable.
- [ ] Protected surfaces and promotion thresholds are unchanged, or reviewed separately.
